title: "Butter" Flies | Butter Themed Bees
description: These are bees that have the appearance of butter sticks. Get it? Cause butterflies? Ok, sorry for the bad pun...
body:
Born from a silly idea. These are bees that have the appearance of butter sticks. Get it? Cause butterflies? Ok, sorry for the bad pun...

Anyway, this pack currently incudes retextures for all of the bees, including the new babies, with the nectar/pollen. The blue colour is how they will normally appear and then turn red when angered because most butter sticks are either blue or red depending on if they are salted or not. And this kind of gives the idea that the red, angry bees are being "salty".

I may add more to this in the future, but right now it was a silly idea for April Fools.
